description: Reviewed deviations between implemented SA 2026 bindings and the committed exact-target inventory, checked by ExactTargetEvidenceCrossCheckTests (#272). Each entry suppresses exactly one finding (command, argument, implemented binding, kind); stale entries fail the test.
